constraints.statement: Detached toilet 25 is image-left of main block 15; it connects at every corresponding floor; entrances face the teaching block.
Six basketball courts in a 3 by 2 arrangement.
The court block and adjacent straight track are parallel and directly adjacent; no road or green buffer is inserted. The track lies between the sports auxiliary rooms and courts.
constraints.id_binding_status: editorial binding, not historic official name

constraints.statement: Sports auxiliary rooms are low single-storey buildings on image-left of the track; functions include exercise, PE office and equipment storage. Three functions do not establish three buildings or rooms.
Music building 24 is a detached four-storey building beside the track and behind the gymnasium; it is not merged with single-storey auxiliary rooms.
Pool toilet 26 is image-left of pool 04; the sketch places music, WC and pool at the same end of the three strips. Do not copy main-toilet interior layout into 26.
Rostrum on image-left side of athletics field.
Natural school-name stone to the right of the gate in the reference street-facing photograph.
